research_question: Does aggressive order imbalance measured only in the completed first ten seconds of UTC quarter-hour openings predict executable Binance USD-M returns strongly enough to improve account NAV after realistic costs, funding, concentration and account-path controls?

economic_hypotheses.prediction: The sign of completed first-ten-second aggressive quote-notional imbalance predicts the same sign of subsequent return.
The same rule at minute offsets 07, 22, 37 and 52 should be materially weaker; it is a placebo and cannot promote by itself.
A factor-reduced long-high-imbalance/short-low-imbalance basket has positive net expectancy when cross-sectional dispersion is large.

information_contract.event_clock: UTC exchange transaction time from official archives
information_contract.entry: initial fatal screen enters no earlier than the next exact one-minute contract open; a one-additional-minute delay is a frozen stress
information_contract.later_exact_execution: bookTicker replay remains unopened unless a frozen initial survivor exists
information_contract.same_bar_order: gap/stop first, then horizon; no favorable intrabar ordering
information_contract.missing_data: exact one-minute grid; no imputation across missing signal, entry, stop, mark or exit observations

data_contract.integrity: Every requested archive must match its adjacent Binance CHECKSUM or be explicitly unavailable before strategy computation.
data_contract.aggtrade_sign: buyer-maker true is aggressive sell; false is aggressive buy
data_contract.opening_imbalance: sum(signed price*quantity)/sum(price*quantity) over the completed ten-second window
data_contract.activity_ratio: event quote notional divided by the prior 24 same-phase event median for the same symbol; current and future events excluded
data_contract.funding: recorded funding rate at its timestamp with contemporaneous official mark open; no inferred future funding
data_contract.capacity: entry notional cannot exceed 0.1 percent of the immediately preceding completed one-minute contract quote volume

stages.selection: 2023 systematic dates remain unopened until a frozen development survivor
stages.validation: 2024 remains unopened until a frozen 2023 primary

account_contract.cross_sectional_basket: equal gross long and short notional; account-level gross leverage and per-leg costs enforced
account_contract.terminal_loss: NAV at or below zero is -100% return and 100% drawdown
